name: frenchie pull up
description: A pull-up series with a pause at three elbow angles, one angle per rep. It builds the strength to hold a bent arm at any point of the pull, which climbers need to lock off and reach.
instructions: Hang from a pull-up bar with your hands about shoulder-width apart and your arms straight.
Pull up until your chin is over the bar and hold that top position for 3-5 seconds, then lower to a straight-arm hang.
Pull up again, lower until your elbows are bent at 90 degrees and hold for 3-5 seconds, then lower to a straight-arm hang.
Pull up again, lower until your elbows are only partly bent, at about 120 degrees, and hold for 3-5 seconds.
Lower to a straight-arm hang with control. These three pull-ups make one cycle.
Keep your shoulders pulled down and avoid swinging between holds.
